name: 6 nimmt!
edition: 30th anniversary edition rulebook, 2024 (version 1.0), base game section

key_numbers.label: Cards a row holds before the next one forces a take

setup.text: Turn four cards face up in a column. Each starts a row. Put the rest aside for later rounds.
Get the notepad and pencil ready to record penalty points.

turn.summary: Everyone picks a card, all are revealed, and cards are placed lowest first into the rows. Taking a row costs points.
steps: Everyone chooses a card and puts it face down in front of them. Reveal them once all have chosen.
From the lowest card up, each player places theirs at the end of a row. It must be higher than the row's last card, and go in the row where the difference is smallest.
If your card would be the sixth in a row, take the five cards into your bull pile; your card becomes the first of the row.
If your card is lower than every row's last card, take any row of your choice and start it with your card.
Repeat until all 10 cards have been played.

round_end: Count the bullheads on your bull pile and write them down as negative points, then start a new round.
end: Play rounds until someone reaches 66 points or more. You may agree another target or a set number of rounds.

scoring.text: Each bullhead on the cards you took is one negative point.
Most cards have 1 bullhead. Numbers ending in 5 have 2, multiples of 10 have 3, doubles (11, 22, 33...) have 5, and 55 has 7.

tiebreak: Players tied on the lowest total share the win.

missed.text: Placement order goes by card value, lowest first, so a lower card can change which row a higher one must take.
Always use the smallest difference among the rows where your card is higher. You cannot choose another row.
The sixth card in a row triggers the take, not the fifth.
Cards you take go in your bull pile, never your hand.
With a low card you may choose which row to take; usually pick the one with the fewest bullheads.

not_covered: Cooperative 'Beat the Buffalo' variant for 1-6 players.
